entire-repo.description: Every file in the PR diff (default).

airflow.focus: Review as an Airflow and Astro specialist: DAG and task correctness, scheduling and idempotency, top-level code that slows DAG parsing, provider and operator usage, connections and secrets handling, and dependency or runtime-image compatibility.

data-engineer.description: Everything a data engineer cares about: Airflow/Astro files, SQL, and dbt.
data-engineer.focus: Review as a data engineer: in addition to Airflow and Astro correctness, check SQL for correctness, join fan-out, NULL handling, partition and incremental-load logic, idempotent re-runs, query cost and performance, and dbt model, test, and materialization choices. Treat schema changes as potentially breaking for downstream consumers.

platform-engineer.description: Everything a platform engineer cares about: Terraform, containers, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.
platform-engineer.focus: Review as a platform engineer: infrastructure-as-code safety (destructive or replace-forcing changes, state and drift risk), least-privilege IAM and permissions, secrets exposure, network exposure, container image hygiene and pinning, CI/CD pipeline correctness and supply-chain risk, and resource limits, scaling, and rollback behavior.
